sources.finding: Runtime contains real webcam/audio capture paths plus a distinct virtual/Ghost fallback. Runtime capability is not itself a captured user measurement archive.
Committed state is explicitly virtual/default state and is not eligible as a real user biosignal record.
Apple Health ingestion support exists, but no source Apple Health export.xml measurement archive was found in the reviewed repository evidence. Provider code alone is not measurement evidence.

Local-first Bio/CNS pipeline implements consent, quality/timestamp handling, personal baselines, persistent event ledger, heartbeat records, schemas, and sensor adapters. Its documented quick demo uses a DeterministicCardiacAdapter, so demo output is synthetic/test data rather than proof of a captured user archive.

HEARTLIGHT may carry explicitly entered or approved-sensor observations such as pulse, is local-first, and explicitly instructs contributors not to submit real private health/recording records to the public repository.

gate_resolution: D001-TWIN remains blocked for weight training until a private or otherwise provenance-verifiable measurement bundle is explicitly supplied/mounted and produces source-hashed TWIN_STATE_PACKET records. The runtime architecture needed to ingest such measurements is verified and ready.
bounded_interpretation: The repositories verify a substantial bio/sensor capture and integration architecture, but this audit did not find a publicly committed user-specific biosignal archive that can be defensibly identified as the user's measured physiology. This is consistent with the repositories' local-first/privacy boundaries and must not be rewritten as evidence that no private measurements exist elsewhere.
